name: Find
use: Use to reach one animal by typing part of her ear tag or her pen, from anywhere: type, tap one, act. A white input page with the field pinned and focused; nothing is listed before typing; results are one card per unit, this unit first. Each row is the tag over her pen with the host's right side: a pig on the task's list shows the task's state, any other pig her condition tags (owner, 2026-10-22). Farrowing's Find a sow, Inspection's and Home's Find a pig.
notUse: Not for picking from a short known list (use ChoiceList or a picker); not for narrowing a list already on screen (use FilterSheet); not for collecting several animals (use Scan).
states: Results · this unit first, then the others
In a task · its row for pigs on its list

name: Scan
use: Use to read tags hands-free with the reader. What a read does is the host's job (owner, 2026-10-22): a multi-select place (Home, Inspection's walk) ticks each pig as she is read, newest first, and the footer becomes the count and Actions, or a task's own actions directly; a single-action task (Farrowing) opens her on each read, so nothing is listed (read:'open'). A Sheet page on the tint whose rows are the context's own animal row with its tick box.
notUse: Not for finding one animal by typing (use Find); not for choosing pigs from a list already on screen (scan on the list with the scan bar); never a Select button.
states: Ticks · each read ticked (a multi-select place)
Its own actions · a multi-select task
Opens · a single-action task lists nothing

name: Scan bar
use: Use when a page that chooses animals from a list scans in place (owner, 2026-10-22): the page's scan button turns its search bar into this bar while the reader is on. Scanning wears the scan hue (the progress wash Row's Just scanned uses); waiting for the reader wears the pending colours until it connects. Stop ends either and the search field returns.
notUse: Not as a page header or a footer, and never beside a second scanning status; not on Scan's own page (its footer's Stop / Resume scanning is the status there).
